ACME-RAD-014.title: Acme Health Medical Policy ACME-RAD-014: MRI of the Lumbar Spine (CPT 72148)
ACME-RAD-014.summary: MRI of the lumbar spine is considered medically necessary for low back pain with radiculopathy when ALL of the following criteria are documented in the medical record.

criteria.text: Low back pain and/or radicular symptoms have persisted for at least 6 weeks.
criteria.denial_reason: Duration of symptoms of at least 6 weeks is not documented. A follow-up interval is not evidence of symptom duration.

criteria.text: Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (e.g., physical therapy, NSAIDs), with the duration of therapy documented.
criteria.denial_reason: Documentation of the duration of conservative therapy (minimum 6 weeks) was not provided.

criteria.text: No MRI of the lumbar spine within the previous 12 months.
criteria.denial_reason: Absence of recent lumbar spine imaging is not documented.

NS-IMG-207.title: Northstar Clinical Guideline NS-IMG-207: MRI of the Knee (CPT 73721)
NS-IMG-207.summary: Knee MRI is approved for suspected internal derangement when ALL of the following are documented.

criteria.text: Mechanical symptoms (locking, catching) or instability (giving way) of the knee.
criteria.denial_reason: Mechanical symptoms or instability are not documented.

criteria.text: Plain radiographs (X-ray) of the knee completed within the past 6 months.
criteria.denial_reason: Recent knee radiographs are not documented.

criteria.text: At least 4 weeks of conservative treatment (activity modification, home exercise, NSAIDs) without adequate improvement.
criteria.denial_reason: At least 4 weeks of conservative treatment is not documented.

ACME-RAD-022.title: Acme Health Medical Policy ACME-RAD-022: MRI of the Knee (CPT 73721)
ACME-RAD-022.summary: Knee MRI requires documented mechanical symptoms and recent radiographs.

criteria.text: Mechanical symptoms or instability of the knee.
Knee radiographs within the past 6 months.

NS-IMG-115.title: Northstar Clinical Guideline NS-IMG-115: MRI of the Lumbar Spine (CPT 72148)
NS-IMG-115.summary: Lumbar MRI requires 6 weeks of failed conservative therapy.

criteria.text: At least 6 weeks of failed conservative therapy, with duration documented.
criteria.denial_reason: Duration of conservative therapy is not documented.
